title: Crimson Mischief

sources.title: Prey Upon the Weak
markers: | description = This weapon deals an additional {{DamageText|1d4|Piercing}} damage against targets with 50% of their [[Hit Points|hit points]] or fewer.

sources.title: Redvein Savagery
markers: | description = When you make an attack with {{Advantage}}, the target takes an additional {{DamageText|7|Piercing|drs=t}} damage.

sources.title: Crimson Weapon
markers: | description = When you make an attack with your off-hand weapon, you can add your [[Ability_Score_Modifier|Ability Modifier]] to the damage of the attack.

summary: This +2 shortsword adds Piercing damage in the main hand and ability modifier damage in the off hand.

fields.Prey Upon the Weak: Deal an extra 1d4 Piercing against targets at or below half HP. The tooltip can show the same die twice.
fields.Main hand: Redvein Savagery adds 7 Piercing on attacks with this sword made with advantage. Tactician and lower can apply it again to main-hand melee Sneak Attack.
fields.Training note: The pinned source reports Scimitar proficiency also works with this shortsword.
fields.Off hand: Crimson Weapon lets you add your ability modifier to off-hand attack damage, including a hand crossbow.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
